title: Recovery Charges Rate Card — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tiers
content:
**Recovery & Remarketing rate card — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

These are the tier figures for repossession assignment, the notice mailing period and repossession expenses on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract.

### Assignment threshold by tier

| Tier | Minimum days past due before an account may be assigned for repossession |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 45 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 60 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 60 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 75 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 75 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 90 |

### Figures common to every tier (Tier 5 through Tier 1+)

| Figure | Amount or period |
|---|---|
| Notice mailing period: business days after repossession within which the notice of intent to sell is mailed | 3 business days |
| Repossession agency fee, involuntary recovery | $400.00 |
| Agency fee, voluntary surrender | $150.00 |
| Transport fee for the tier (involuntary recovery) | $135.00 |
| Condition report fee, once per repossession | $65.00 |
| Daily storage fee for the tier | $18.00 per day |
| Free days for the tier (storage days not charged after repossession) | 3 days |
| Personal property hold | 15 calendar days |

### Notes

- The transport fee, the daily storage fee and the free days are the same on every pre-owned tier.
- The agency fee depends on how the vehicle came back: $400.00 for an involuntary recovery and $150.00 for a voluntary surrender.
- The personal property hold is counted in calendar days; the notice mailing period in business days.
